Plugin.Name: U-Manager Push Notifications
Plugin.Overview:
Delivers your Unraid notifications to the U-Manager app on iOS and Android as push notifications.
- Registers itself as a Dynamix Notifications agent, so whatever Unraid raises reaches your phone with the same subject and description. - Forwards to the device whose push token you paste into the plugin settings. - Needs U-Manager app 1.2.1 or newer. Earlier versions cannot generate the push token.
